code:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalRows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Email IS NULL
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NullEmails,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Email
       IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,2))
       AS NullEmailPct
FROM dbo.Customers;
caption: Use 100.0, not 100 — integer division truncates to zero.

code:
SELECT Email, COUNT(*) AS DupeCount
FROM dbo.Customers
GROUP BY Email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
caption: Follow-up: ROW_NUMBER() when you need the actual duplicate rows.

code:
SELECT o.OrderId, o.CustomerId
FROM dbo.Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN dbo.Customers AS c
  ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE c.CustomerId IS NULL
  AND o.CustomerId IS NOT NULL;
caption: The second condition excludes intentional, legitimate NULLs.

code:
SELECT 'Email must be present' AS Rule,
  CAST(CustomerId AS VARCHAR(20)) AS Key
FROM dbo.Customers WHERE Email IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT 'CustomerId must exist', CAST(o.OrderId AS VARCHAR(20))
FROM dbo.Orders o LEFT JOIN dbo.Customers c
  ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.CustomerId IS NULL;
caption: Cast every RecordKey to the same type before UNION ALL.
